title: Dubrovnik's Walls ~$45, Xi'an's Bigger Ming Wall ~$8 | China Travel Expert
description:
Walking Dubrovnik's famous old-town walls costs about $45 (€40) in 2026. Xi'an's city wall — older, taller and vastly bigger — runs about $8 (¥54).

Xi'an's Ming-dynasty wall was built from 1370 to 1378 on earlier Tang foundations. It forms a complete rectangle roughly 13.7 km around, about 12 m tall and 12–14 m wide at the top — wide enough that you can rent a bike and ride the entire loop, which takes around two hours at an easy pace.

🧭 Expert Tip: Rent a bike on top of the wall near the South Gate and ride the full ~13.7 km circuit — it's the best way to see all four gates, and the loop takes about two hours.
